name: Swap Meet
text: Before casting, everyone passes 2 cards face down to the left.

name: Flip the Script
text: After the flip, everyone chooses at once: keep your totals, or swap your ATK and BLK.

name: The Turf
text: Line limit 10, cast up to 4 cards.

name: Clean Kit
text: A Trigger Thumb roll of 1 counts as nothing.

name: Bleeding
text: Last on ATK takes +1 damage; last on BLK takes +1 damage.

name: Mugged
text: After ranking, ATK ranks rotate: 1st drops to last, everyone else moves up 1.
